  • Method Details

    • setUp

      @BeforeEach void setUp()
      Sets up the test environment before each test method. Initializes a new DocumentChunker object.

    • testChunkWithNormalText

      @Test void testChunkWithNormalText()
      Tests chunking a normal text with punctuation, stop words, and numbers. Verifies that punctuation is removed, stop words and pure numbers are excluded.

    • testChunkWithOnlyStopWords

      @Test void testChunkWithOnlyStopWords()
      Tests chunking text that contains only stop words. Verifies that the result is an empty list.

    • testChunkWithOnlyNumbers

      @Test void testChunkWithOnlyNumbers()
      Tests chunking text that contains only numbers and punctuation. Verifies that pure numbers are excluded and an empty list is returned.

    • testChunkWithNullInput

      @Test void testChunkWithNullInput()
      Tests chunking a null input. Verifies that an empty list is returned instead of a NullPointerException.

    • testChunkWithEmptyInput

      @Test void testChunkWithEmptyInput()
      Tests chunking an empty string input. Verifies that an empty list is returned.

    • testCombineChunksWithValidList

      @Test void testCombineChunksWithValidList()
      Tests combining a valid list of chunks into a single string. Verifies that chunks are joined correctly with spaces.

    • testCombineChunksWithNullList

      @Test void testCombineChunksWithNullList()
      Tests combining a null list of chunks. Verifies that an empty string is returned.

    • testCombineChunksWithEmptyList

      @Test void testCombineChunksWithEmptyList()
      Tests combining an empty list of chunks. Verifies that an empty string is returned.
